cards.card_text: They serve Baal and the Ashtoreths, more false gods, and they provoke the LORD to anger.
cards.verse_text: They bowed down to them and provoked the LORD to anger, for they forsook Him and served Baal and the Ashtoreths.
cards.snippet: …LORD to anger, for they forsook Him and served Baal and the Ashtoreths.

cards.card_text: And again the Israelites do evil in the sight of the LORD, serving the Baals, the Ashtoreths, and the gods of Aram, Sidon, Moab, the Ammonites and the Philistines.
cards.verse_text: They served the Baals, the Ashtoreths, the gods of Aram, Sidon, and Moab, and the gods of the Ammonites and Philistines.
cards.snippet: They served the Baals, the Ashtoreths, the gods of Aram, Sidon, and Moab, and the gods of the…

cards.card_text: The foreign gods and Ashtoreths The weapons of their fighting men The gold from the guilt offering
cards.verse_text: Then Samuel said to all the house of Israel, “If you are returning to the LORD with all your hearts, then put away the foreign gods and Ashtoreths among you, prepare your hearts for the LORD, and serve Him only.
cards.snippet: …LORD with all your hearts, then put away the foreign gods and Ashtoreths among you, prepare your hearts for the LORD, and serve Him only.

cards.card_text: And Israel actually does it: out go the Baals and Ashtoreths, those foreign gods, and they serve only the LORD.
cards.verse_text: So the Israelites put away the Baals and Ashtoreths and served only the LORD.
cards.snippet: So the Israelites put away the Baals and Ashtoreths and served only the LORD.

cards.card_text: They admit they served the Baals and Ashtoreths, false gods, and ask the LORD to deliver them so they can serve Him.
cards.verse_text: Then they cried out to the LORD and said, ‘We have sinned, for we have forsaken the LORD and served the Baals and Ashtoreths.
cards.snippet: …sinned, for we have forsaken the LORD and served the Baals and Ashtoreths.

cards.card_text: Saul's armor goes into the temple of the Ashtoreths, false goddesses.
cards.verse_text: They put his armor in the temple of the Ashtoreths and hung his body on the wall of Beth-shan.
cards.snippet: They put his armor in the temple of the Ashtoreths and hung his body on the wall of Beth-shan.
